feeds.title: CALMINGPRESENCE
feeds.description: I'm Sara, an Early Years Teacher from Oxford. I was born in Scotland, and have lived in a variety of places in England before settling in Oxford, which has now been my home for over 15 years. Talking about my experiences, I have strong feelings on racism, Islamophobia and feminism, which I may talk about in some posts. I am also very protective of children and would adopt all the vulnerable children in the world if I could! I am a dreamer and want to explore the world, help others, learn more.

feeds.title: Happy Muslim Mama
feeds.description: Welcome to Happy Muslim Mama by UmmSalihah Ahmed. I started blogging eight years ago because I did not know anyone else who was a working Muslim mother. People my age were not married with children at the time, Muslim mothers my age that had children did not work. I felt caught up in a unique situation with no one to share the journey with. Being a working Muslim mama brought challenges, learning and growth that I wanted to share with the world and see if anyone else shared my experiences.

feeds.description: altMuslimah is a web magazine featuring content on a wide variety of issues pertaining to gender-and-Islam, with a specific focus on American Muslim women's stories and lived experiences. We celebrate storytelling, personal narratives, creative exchanges, and conversations among scholars, professional experts, and lay readers.

feeds.title: Margari Aziza
feeds.description: Margari Aziza Hill is co-founder and Programming Director of Muslim Anti-Racism Collaborative (MuslimARC), assistant editor at AltM, columnist at MuslimMatters, and co-founder of Muslims Make it Plain. She is a Women's Policy Institute-County fellow, joining the First for Women team on protecting women's religious rights in the criminal justice system in LA County.

feeds.title: Muslim Women Connect Blog
feeds.description: Muslim Women Connect creates a platform for women to meet, share knowledge and give back through mentoring. By creating relatable role models and matching them up with women who are starting out in their journey, we provide a structured environment for women's goals and ambitions to be nurtured. We aim to inspire all Muslim women to reach their potential and continue to personally develop by creating meaningful connections.
